topic: What antenna aperture size trade-offs exist between LEO and GEO satellites when optimizing gain and portability for CMOS-based ground terminals?
consensus_response: LEO satellites require smaller apertures with precise beam steering due to lower free space path loss and shorter signal propagation delays, while GEO satellites need larger apertures with robust amplification. Phased array technology and beamforming algorithms optimize aperture size, balancing gain, portability, and interference mitigation.
reference_context: SatCom systems involve trade-offs between LEO and GEO satellites, considering factors like beam size, free space path loss, and signal propagation delay.
